Choose either the blue or red player along with your friend and dodge all the bullets. Every time you touch a bullet, the duration increases by 1 second, so be careful and avoid touching them. Compete with your friend and win; you need to defeat your friend.

Instructions

Press WASD keys to move the red player Press the Arrow keys to move the blue player Dodge for 100 seconds and the first one to finish the time wins
